scenario_en: On a product-category classification problem you are debating whether to spend time building out the graph signal bucket.

scenario: 同一家公司里，推荐重排已换成序列 transformer，而 fraud 风控团队今天仍在上线几十个手工数值特征。
q: 手工数值特征今天主要活在哪些地方？
options: 只活在遗留系统里，新建的系统一律不再使用它们
活在轻 ranker、树模型与 fraud 风控场景里
活在多模态 backbone 的输入层，用来替代原始图像与文本
活在 embedding 表里，作为高基数 ID 的替代表示
options_en: Only in legacy systems; anything newly built has stopped using them.
In light rankers, tree models, and fraud and trust-and-safety systems.
In the input layer of multimodal backbones, replacing raw images and text.
Inside embedding tables, as a substitute for high-cardinality IDs.
optionExplanations: 风控团队今天还在新上线这类特征，不是历史遗留。
宽漏斗要便宜特征，树天生吃标量，风控还要能解释每个信号。
原始图像走 patch 编码、文本走 tokenizer，都不靠人工标量替代。
高基数 ID 用 embedding 表或 hashing trick，跟数值变换是两条路。
optionExplanations_en: Fraud teams are shipping these today, so this is not a legacy leftover.
The wide funnel needs cheap features, trees natively consume scalars, and risk teams need explainable signals.
Raw images go through patch encoding and text through a tokenizer; neither is replaced by hand-made scalars.
High-cardinality IDs use embedding tables or the hashing trick, a separate path from numeric transforms.
why: 轻 ranker 要便宜、树模型吃标量、风控要可解释，这三处让手工数值特征留了下来。代价是这些特征的口径和新鲜度都要你自己维护。
why_en: Light rankers need cheap inputs, tree models consume scalars natively, and risk teams need explainability, which is why hand-crafted numerics survive, at the cost of owning their definition and freshness yourself.
tradeoff: 手工数值特征 vs 原始序列进 transformer：算力与可解释 vs 表达能力
whenOtherWins: 在窄漏斗的重 ranker 上，把原始 (item, action, timestamp) 序列交给 transformer，效果通常压过任何手工聚合。

termDefinitions.meaning: 信任与安全：识别滥用、欺诈与有害内容的方向。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: T and S, trust and safety, is the domain that detects abuse, fraud, and harmful content.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把高基数 ID 哈希进固定数量的桶，多个 ID 共享一行向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The hashing trick hashes high-cardinality IDs into a fixed bucket count so several IDs share one row.

q_en: Where do hand-crafted numeric features still live today?
scenario_en: At the same company the recommendation re-ranker is now a sequence transformer, yet the fraud team still ships dozens of hand-crafted numeric features today.

scenario: 排序模型换成 transformer 后，团队认为特征不用讨论了，于是只喂了视频侧信号，没喂用户停留时长。
q: 换成 transformer 为什么没省掉信号源的讨论？
options: transformer 参数量大，需要喂进更多特征才不至于欠拟合、白白浪费参数容量
模型能学 dwell time 与创作者信誉的交互，前提是两个信号都进了输入
transformer 只能处理文本，数值信号必须人工加工
注意力机制学不了特征交叉，仍要手工造交叉项
options_en: A transformer has many parameters and needs more features fed in to avoid underfitting and wasting capacity.
The model can learn how dwell time interacts with creator reputation, but only if both signals are in the input.
Transformers only handle text, so numeric signals must be hand-engineered.
Attention cannot learn feature crosses, so you still hand-build cross terms.
optionExplanations: 欠拟合与信号缺失是两回事，堆无关特征不解决缺源。
学交互是模型的强项，但它学不出你根本没给它的东西。
transformer 同样吃图像 patch、ID embedding 和标量。
学交叉正是注意力最擅长的事，不需要手工造交叉项。
optionExplanations_en: Underfitting and a missing source are different problems; piling on unrelated features fixes neither.
Learning interactions is the model’s strength, but it cannot learn from what you never gave it.
Transformers also consume image patches, ID embeddings, and scalars.
Learning crosses is exactly what attention is good at, so hand-built cross terms are unnecessary.
why: 模型能自己学交互，学不出没喂进去的信号；生产里「模型学不到我们要的东西」多半是漏了源、源过期，或训练与服务算法不一致。
why_en: The model learns interactions on its own but cannot learn a signal you never fed it, and most production cases of the model not learning what we want trace to a missing source, a stale source, or one computed inconsistently.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户在一条内容上停留的时间，衡量兴趣强度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dwell time is how long a user lingers on an item, used as a proxy for interest.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个特征组合起来才产生的非线性效应。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature interaction is a nonlinear effect that appears only when two features are combined.

q_en: Why does moving to a transformer not remove the need to discuss signal sources?
scenario_en: After switching the ranker to a transformer the team decides features need no discussion, feeding only video-side signals and omitting user dwell time.

scenario: 一家单体电商想自建交易反欺诈模型，手里只有本站商户自己的交易数据。
q: 相比 Stripe Radar，它天然缺哪一类特征？
options: 缺实时特征，因为单商户做不了流式聚合
缺跨商户的卡网络特征——单商户复制不了「见过 90% 的卡」
缺文本特征，因为交易记录里没有自然语言
缺标注数据，只有零星 chargeback，只能退化成无监督异常检测
options_en: Real-time features, since a single merchant cannot do streaming aggregation.
Cross-merchant card-network features, since one merchant cannot replicate having seen 90% of cards.
Text features, since transaction records contain no natural language.
Labels are scarce, with only sporadic chargebacks, so it degrades to unsupervised anomaly detection.
optionExplanations: 流式聚合是通用基建，单商户照样能搭。
这张卡在别家商户的历史，是数据位置决定的护城河，加特征补不上。
交易里确有地址、描述等文本，且文本不是这里的关键差距。
单商户也有 chargeback 作为标签，只是量小，不是结构性缺口。
optionExplanations_en: Streaming aggregation is generic infrastructure that a single merchant can build too.
A card’s history at other merchants is a moat set by data position, and no amount of feature work closes it.
Transactions do carry text such as addresses and descriptions, and text is not the key gap here.
A single merchant still gets chargebacks as labels, just fewer, so this is not the structural gap.
why: Stripe 每笔交易打 1000+ 信号，最强的一类来自跨商户卡历史，这是数据位置带来的优势。代价是接平台风控意味着把这条信号的所有权交出去。
why_en: Stripe scores over a thousand signals per transaction and its strongest class comes from cross-merchant card history, an advantage of data position, so buying it means handing ownership of that signal to the platform.
tradeoff: 自建单商户模型 vs 接平台风控：数据可控 vs 网络效应特征
whenOtherWins: 如果欺诈模式高度垂直（比如只针对本站的优惠券套利），自家商户内的行为特征反而比通用网络信号更准。

termDefinitions.meaning: Stripe 的支付反欺诈系统，每笔交易评估上千个信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stripe Radar is Stripe’s payment fraud system that scores over a thousand signals per transaction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持卡人向发卡行申诉后强制退款，是反欺诈的主要标签来源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A chargeback is a forced refund after the cardholder disputes a charge, the main label source for fraud models.

q_en: Compared with Stripe Radar, which class of feature does it structurally lack?
scenario_en: A standalone e-commerce site wants to build its own transaction fraud model with only its own merchant transaction data.

scenario: 风控模型 flag 过的账号，后续收到人工举报的速度明显更快，团队把「举报到达速度」当成了强特征。
q: 这个特征暴露了什么问题？
options: 标注噪声：人工举报本身就不够可靠
冷启动：新注册账号还没有任何举报历史
反馈环：特征测的是「模型是否已 flag」
概念漂移：用户举报行为的分布随时间自然发生变化
options_en: Label noise: user reports are simply not reliable enough.
Cold start: newly registered accounts have no report history yet.
A feedback loop: the feature measures whether the model already flagged it.
Concept drift: the distribution of user reporting behavior naturally changes over time.
optionExplanations: 举报确实有噪声，但这里的偏差来自模型自己的决策。
冷启动是历史为空，这里的账号有历史，只是历史被模型影响了。
被 flag 的账号会被优先展示给审核队列，举报自然更快到达。
漂移是外部世界变化，这里是系统内部自我强化。
optionExplanations_en: Reports are noisy, but the bias here comes from the model’s own decisions.
Cold start means empty history; these accounts have history, it is just history the model shaped.
Flagged accounts get surfaced to review queues sooner, so reports naturally arrive faster.
Drift is the outside world changing; this is the system reinforcing itself.
why: 反馈环不止出现在推荐里：模型的决策改变了它自己的训练特征，训练数据于是不断证明模型是对的。缓解是加随机探索或按 propensity 做 IPW 加权，代价是拿一部分流量换无偏数据。
why_en: Feedback loops are not only a recommendation problem: the model’s decisions reshape its own training features so the data keeps confirming it was right, and mitigating with randomized exploration or inverse propensity weighting costs you a slice of traffic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 逆倾向加权：按样本被展示的概率的倒数加权，纠正曝光偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IPW, inverse propensity weighting, reweights each sample by the inverse of its exposure probability to correct selection bias.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型当时把这条样本展示出去的概率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Propensity is the probability that the model chose to surface that sample at the time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 风控系统把账号或内容标为可疑，送进人工审核队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: To flag is to mark an account or item as suspicious and route it to human review.

q_en: What problem does this feature expose?
scenario_en: Accounts the risk model has flagged receive user reports noticeably faster, and the team adopts report arrival speed as a strong feature.
